rows.abstract: "Seat Belts Use Act of 1998". For their own safety, the driver and front seat passengers of a public or private motor vehicle are required to wear or use their seat belt devices at all times, while driving or riding a vehicle. Car manufacturers, assemblers and distributors are likewise required to ensure that seat belt devices are installed in vehicles.
